timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I just hit send and now I am spiraling.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind is replaying exactly what I wrote.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am imagining how they might take it the wrong way.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep rereading it in my head.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels anxious waiting for a response.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I wish I could take it back and rewrite it.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me is convinced I said the wrong thing.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel exposed right now.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This is taking up so much of my attention.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let this message exist without controlling the reaction.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Rereading it will not change what I sent.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Most likely, they are not analyzing it the way I am.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not have to imagine every possible reaction.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle while I wait.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I said something honest, and that is allowed.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: One message does not define how someone sees me.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can trust that I meant well.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can put this down for now.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust myself to communicate honestly.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind can let this go.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am allowed to send something imperfect.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can focus on what is in front of me now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can relax about this.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can handle whatever response comes.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I do not need to be perfect in every message.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I am someone who communicates with care.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to let this be finished.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
